purpose: Harden the Windows Designer UIA protocol loop against transient semantic-tree COM object invalidation during selection, editing, structure commands, reopen, and diagnostic navigation

local.python_validation: tests/uia_designer_reader_loop.py and tests/platform_acceptance_tests.py compiled; git diff --check passed
local.scope: The UIA loop retries transient COM/UIA failures and re-queries current Designer elements; protocol and process-liveness output remains separate from Narrator/NVDA speech sign-off.

limitations: The hosted UIA loop does not provide a signed-in desktop Narrator or NVDA speech observation.
Narrator/NVDA/Orca/VoiceOver speech, real IME, drag/drop, Inspector, DPI/theme, clean-machine packaging, and one-hour soak remain operator platform checks.
